description: Phase 8 cross-backend validation on ibm_kingston for mitigated gr_affine_n4 direct-distribution loading. This repeats the strongest Phase 7 ibm_fez global distribution claim on a second backend.
rationale: Mitigated gr_affine_n4 was the only Phase 7 paper-quality global distribution result on ibm_fez.
A Kingston repeat tests whether that claim is backend-specific or reproducible across comparable Heron-class devices.
The campaign measures only direct distribution loading and selected quantity-of-interest functionals.

selected_cases.label: affine probability law, 16 midpoint cells
selected_cases.purpose: Cross-backend validation of the strongest mitigated sixteen-cell distribution result.

stopping_rules: If TVD stays below 0.03 and max cell deviation below 0.01, promote gr_affine_n4 as cross-backend paper-quality distribution evidence.
If TVD worsens above 0.04, treat the Fez result as backend-dependent and report Kingston as a diagnostic control.
Do not attach Grover amplification in this campaign.
